decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - It is anticipted that tree roots will have grown parallel with the wall such that they will not be affected by the proposed excavation. Nevertheless excavation works shall be hand-dug and no roots more than 10mm in diameter shall be severed.

Condition : 4 - The new arch shall be created with minimum disturbance to the wall; maximum re-use shall be made of the existing bricks. Any new bricks shall be compatable with the old in terms of appearance, texture, water absorption, strength, and bond pattern. Mortar shall be lime:sand using 3.5 natural haydraulic lime (N.H.L.) in proportion 1:2.5 sand, with well graded grit to fine mix, or as otherwise advised by specialist contractor. THe mortar shall be flush and compacted by brush tamping, fully protected from frost and rapid drying.
description: Erection of greenhouse in rear garden of existing house.
